displayConfig.template:
<Stack gap="sm" p="xs">
  <Group justify="space-between" align="center">
    <Group gap="xs">
      <Avatar src="https://jellyglance.com/project-logo.png" size={24} radius="xl" />
      <Stack gap={0}>
        <Text fw={800} size="sm">Jellyfin jobs</Text>
        <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{data.running} running</Text>
      </Stack>
    </Group>
    <Badge variant="light" color={data.ok ? "teal" : "red"}>{data.ok ? "Clear" : String(data.failed) + " failed"}</Badge>
  </Group>
  <Grid gutter="xs">
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="blue">Running</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.running}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
    <Grid.Col span={6}><Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs"><Text size="xs" c="red">Failed</Text><Text fw={800} size="lg">{data.failed}</Text></Card></Grid.Col>
  </Grid>
  <Stack gap="xs">
    {data.items.map((row) =>
      <Card withBorder radius="md" p="xs">
        <Group justify="space-between">
          <Text size="sm">{row.name}</Text>
          <Text size="xs" c="dimmed">{row.state}</Text>
        </Group>
      </Card>
    )}
  </Stack>
</Stack>
